sentences.text:
Sections 4/5 Of The Immoral Traffic ... vs In Re: Nirapada
Adhikary & Anr on 1 October, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen  01.10.2024  Court No.29  Item No. 29  Allowed  ar  CRM (A) 3503 of 2024  In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Secti  Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of the B  Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Chatterjeehat   No. 168 of 2024 dated 25.08.2024 corresponding to G.R Ca  2024 under Sections 498A/370/506/34 of
the Indian Penal  Sections 4/5 of the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 19

And  In Re: Nirapada Adhikary & Anr.
 Petiti  Mr. Aniruddha Bhattacharya  Ms. Rai Das  For the Petit  Mr. Subrata Roy  Mr. Dipankar Paramanick  For the State  1.
The petitioner no. 1 is the father-in-law and the petitioner no. 2 is the mother-in-law of the de-facto complainant.
It is alleged that they have been falsely implicated.
2. Learned counsel for the State has produced the case diary.

3. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioners in the commission of the alleged offence, particularly the statement of the victim, which does not name the present petitioners and the principal allegation is against the husband of the petitioner, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioners is not necessary.
Sections 4/5 Of The Immoral Traffic ... vs In Re: Nirapada Adhikary & Anr on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181341820/

1 4 . Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners, namely, Nirapada Adhikary and Sandhya Adhikary shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.5,000/- each, with two registered sureties of Signed By :
AMITAVA ROY High Court of Calcutta 1 st of October 2024 06:39:50 PM like amount each, subject to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also to comply with the conditions as laid down in Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973, corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.

The petitioner no. 1 shall meet the Investigating Officer once in a fornight till the submission of the final report and the petitioner no. 2 shall cooperate with the investigation following the female norms till the submission of the final report and on further condition that the petitioners shall appear before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Howran, on or before 8th October, 2024 from date in connection with G.R Case No. 4184 of 2024.
In the event of non-compliance of any of the conditions, the anticipatory bail shall stand automatically cancelled without any further reference to this Court.
5. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed and the same is accordingly disposed of.
6. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J) (Uday Kumar, J) Signed By :
